component: Account Hub Exchange type state preservation

quotes.text: EWS should restore the previously selected authentication method
An EWS recommendation without a found auth method should not preselect authentication

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Exchange-type component remembers the last EWS authentication choice before Graph forces OAuth2, then restores that EWS value on return. An EWS config without a recognized method starts with the empty placeholder instead of inheriting Graph's OAuth2 choice. Tests directly check the NTLM roundtrip, empty placeholder/Fluent ID and custom tenant/client values across switching. These programmatic state checks do not prove native authentication or account creation.
title: Exchange switching preserves EWS auth without inheriting Graph's forced OAuth choice
